body: This should probably be moved up before `const translation...`

Translations are defined as either a simple string `Search your website` or a function `pageNo => 'Page  ' + pageNo`. Here, we're testing whether the translation we've just retrieved on the above line is a function in order to apply it additional parameters.

Well for all the stupid stuff anyone can do with javascript, I wouldn't write that this way. What is the use case of `Object.create(null)`? Will it apply in our case? If it's not likely, I wouldn't use that... Sanity of the code first because we'll have to maintain it.
If only I had read that correctly in the first place :/

I don't mind either way, but if we do choose to use object prototypes builtins directly in our projects, we should update the [algolia eslint config](https://github.com/algolia/eslint-config-algolia/blob/master/index.js#L50).
What about moving this piece of logic out in a variable and just add the variable here?
What about moving that prop type checker to another file? Or at least another function to be able to keep the same proptypes structure?
Maybe we should move that in a separate file to reuse it across the project.
Oh I wasn't aware of that... Nevermind then :)
Do you mean something like `theme: themePropType(defaultTheme)`?
Or maybe `adapterDesc`, since the primary function of this parameter is to adapt the connector to a particular component's interface?
